name: Capri Denim
author: seaplus
bootlegger: The game ends after day 1. The Storyteller sets a timer for the end of the game. Time pauses for private chats with the Storyteller and with nominations. There is no night phase after executions.
All "once per game" abilities can be used in a private chat with the Storyteller at any time.
Demon kills that usually happen in the night happen after an execution instead.
The Assassin kill may happen immediately or on a specific trigger.
